1174-1912-3664-3869.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-1912-3664-3869.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Biomancer's Familiar, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

280-1993-7857.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
280-1993-7857.description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.

872-3257-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

2403-5220-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-7060.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

582-1409-2499.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve both Brazen Freebooter triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7158.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

5411-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-6159-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-6159-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-6924-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-6924-6968.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1171-7060.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1170-1171-7060.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

640-5010-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

2034-4365-5220-5632-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4365-5220-5632-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and two Clue tokens
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least six phyresis counters on it

3394-3490-5231-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3394-3490-5231-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-4321-4772-5777.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

3490-4050-5789-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4050-5789-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Lifecreed Duo indestructible.
3490-4050-5789-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2358-2656--84.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

1861-6285.notablePrerequisites: You have not activated Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability.
1861-6285.description:
Cast Cut Your Losses by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing a player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus causing the player targeted by Cut Your Losses to mill the rest of their library.
1861-6285.notes: You may use Cut Your Losses's casualty ability, if desired, to cause two players to mill cards.

397-2741-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-2741-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2921-4053-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2921-4053-5944.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.
2921-4053-5944.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bartolomé del Presidio, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

5352-5913.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
5352-5913.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Pinnacle Monk and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Pinnacle Monk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
5352-5913.notes: Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

394-3017-4798-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
394-3017-4798-5686.description:
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a 1/1 Bat creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of River Kelpie

413-3388-3607.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, its Persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with one -1/-1 counter from Persist and +1/+1 counter from its own ability on it.
Remove both counters from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
When Moritte of the Frost enters the battlefield, it, River Kelpie, and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost and River Kelpie abilities, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target. 
Repeat.

4038-5343.notablePrerequisites:
Bigger on the Inside attached to Farmstead Gleaner.
Farmstead Gleaner does not have summoning sickness.
4038-5343.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {2} and causing the next spell you cast to have cascade.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Optionally, you may cast any spell to get infinite cascade triggers based off the mana value of that spell.

145-225-1021-4693.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three enchantments.
145-225-1021-4693.description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.
If you control four or more enchantments, this combo nets infinite mana.

230-643-853-4871.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-643-853-4871.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
When the Eldrazi Scion enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Maskwood Nexus, Lord Skitter's first ability triggers, exiling a card from an opponent's graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Scion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
